newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, pressured by long liquidation amid bearish sentiment, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 yen to 2.6 yen per kg lower.
Benchmark November ended 2.6 yen lower at 130.2 yen.
Activity was lacklustre as most investors were wary of building fresh positions.
"Sentiment remains bearish. With no bullish factors in sight, private investors were liquidating their long positions." one trader said.
"Prices are likely to ease further," he said.
